verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.rainforestpay.com that tells agents to append .md to any docs page for a markdown version. The cited doc URLs are themselves served as .md pages, which corroborates this, and the docs state an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec is supported. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, the llms.txt description is minimal and generic, and the OpenAPI spec was not found at any standard discoverable path (all probes returned 404).
